posts.title: Saturday Morning and Afternoon
posts.description: Slow jog for my morning miles, Morning Prayer, coffee and hot breakfast, somer odds and ends. We visited Chris and Audrey and Scarlett for a long, continuous lunch. Scarlett entertained us with her guitar playing and cookery, and we returned home to chat with Si, Laura, Tom, and Lydia. And now, dinner.

posts.title: Bud Report
posts.description: Back in July, I posted about my JLab Sport ear-bud headphones — although they had been entirely serviceable Bluetooth headphones, the left bud pooped out and would not charge, and I groused about transport charges to and from, and noted with satisfaction that the Soundcore p301 buds that I bought to replace them offered better…

posts.title: Two In A Row
posts.description: Got a good night’s sleep, started the day with a good run/good pace, coffee, fruit, shower, and I’ll go to Morning Prayer and then to get my hair and beard trimmed. And I didn’t forget to blog.
